# Bluefin Tuna LLC — Project Planning Service Agreement

**Proposed effective date:** [effective date after owner/legal sign-off]  
**Version:** `service-terms-2026-10-30-v1`  
**Service provider:** Bluefin Tuna LLC (`we`, `us`, `our`)  
**Contact:** support@bluefintuna.life

### 1. Agreement and order details

By selecting a service, reviewing its scope, and actively accepting these terms at Checkout, the customer (`you`, `your`) agrees to the terms applicable to that order. The order summary, written quotation (if any), the selected service and add-ons, the Cancellation & Refund Policy, and applicable mandatory legal rights form part of the purchase. The order confirmation must identify the service name, quantity/activity allowance, the price in USD, any applicable taxes, and the applicable deliverables. Individually negotiated written terms prevail where legally permitted. App Store app purchases are separate.

### 2. Services and package boundaries

We provide project-planning and project-controls services, including Primavera P6 schedule audits, baseline preparation, reporting-period updates, and separately purchased compatible add-ons. One main package covers one project; one update package covers one reporting period. Current seven-package rates, activity limits, deliverables and turnaround estimates are stated in the product page and order summary. Additional 50-activity blocks, in-scope revisions and individual material categories are billed only when selected and compatible. The customer's purchased scope, not a generic catalog listing, controls the particular engagement. A $1 Schedule Score pilot, if offered, is a limited standalone service only to the extent that its separately published scope and deliverable can actually be fulfilled.

### 3. Additional activities, resources, and materials

Each charged additional-activity block covers *up to 50* activities beyond the core package allowance; any fraction of a block counts as one. Basic Baseline permits up to two added blocks; Detailed Baseline and Update packages up to four. Audits do not permit automatic activity add-ons. `With Resources` ordinarily means client-supplied labor man-hours and cost allocations; material resource categories are additional. Baseline material loading creates an approved category mapping; an Update modifies an existing mapping for one reporting period and requires prior verification. Concrete, reinforcement steel, formwork, structural steel and piping are independent categories. The standard material add-on limit is 50 client-supplied BOQ rows per category, **not 50 physical units**. More complex mapping, extra rows, new resource dictionaries, equipment-hour loading, independent quantity takeoffs, estimates, and new budgets or unit rates require written scope review and possibly an additional quote. An additional in-scope revision does not buy unrelated new work.

### 4. Customer documents and responsibilities

You must provide complete, accurate and authorized files and information relevant to the selected service. These may include a current P6 XER, an approved baseline, BOQ/work descriptions and quantities, specifications/drawings, project constraints, milestone dates, reporting data date, progress measurements, and approved MH/cost budgets or unit rates where relevant. You confirm you have the right to share those documents and that they do not knowingly contain harmful or unlawful content. Preparation and independent verification of the client's BOQ, quantities and budgets are not included unless expressly purchased. File formats are limited to those the secure upload portal currently accepts; do not rely on email or public file links for confidential project documents.

### 5. Acceptance of inputs and delivery period

Published turnaround estimates range from four to twelve business days according to the main package, subject to the selected service scope. The clock begins when all required, usable inputs have been received and accepted, the agreed scope is confirmed, and any applicable payment condition is met — **not merely at payment time**. We communicate material missing information, inconsistencies or changed requirements and the resulting impact on schedule or quotation. Specific business-day calendars and holidays should be shown at the time of purchase or in the accepted written scope. Where an issue prevents us from supplying the purchased service, the Cancellation & Refund Policy and mandatory rights apply.

### 6. Payments and taxes

Unless a written quote states otherwise, quoted prices are one-time charges in USD for the defined scope. Add-ons are itemized separately; no automatic recurring subscription is created by purchasing a planning service. Any taxes that must lawfully be charged are determined in the final checkout/invoice process; a tax calculation setting being disabled does not waive tax obligations. Payments are handled by Stripe. Do not send bank or card credentials in project documents. Chargebacks and disputes will be reviewed against the agreed scope and the actual service/delivery evidence.

### 7. Revisions, deliverables and quality concerns

The purchased service determines the output formats (for example, XER, PDF, XLSX). Included in-scope revisions, if any, are identified on the service page or written order; extra in-scope revisions may be purchased separately. New project scope, additional activity blocks, resource remapping, recovery scheduling or expert claims work are not included unless expressly agreed. You should notify us promptly of missing, corrupted or materially nonconforming deliverables so that we can investigate and, where appropriate, correct, complete or provide another remedy. This does not displace mandatory statutory rights.

### 8. Secure file intake, private workspaces and customer downloads

Customer uploads are first received into private Cloudflare R2 temporary intake. New access to intake files ends **12 hours after the upload session was created**, whether or not the order is paid; automatic deletion normally follows through scheduled cleanup and may be delayed by operational incidents. After a verified payment, accepted files may be transferred into our private, access-controlled Google Drive project workspace for the performance of the purchased service. Google Drive working copies are **separate from** the 12-hour intake deadline. Google account access is not required for customers to download final deliverables; only approved deliverables are provided through authenticated and time-limited Bluefin Tuna portal access. Private working folders, Drive credentials and internal files are not shared with customers.

**Proposed retention schedule (subject to written/legal approval):** temporary R2 intake 12-hour access cutoff; private working files for the project term; customer delivery access 30 days after publication; private working/archive copies scheduled for removal 90 days after publication of the approved final delivery (the proposed operational retention anchor), subject to legally required preservation, disputes or other documented lawful exceptions. Physical deletion runs through scheduled cleanup and may be delayed during operational incidents; access expiry and physical deletion are distinct controls. Order, payment, acceptance and accounting records may have separate legally justified retention periods. The customer is responsible for downloading published final files within the stated availability period. A verified paid order affected by expired or incomplete intake may qualify for an operator-authorized re-upload route. We will describe exceptions and actual data practices in the Privacy Policy before live activation.

### 9. Confidentiality and intellectual property

We will restrict customer documents to personnel and processors with an authorized need to perform the service, subject to the published Privacy Policy and agreed confidentiality requirements. Your original project data remains yours or that of the relevant rights holder. Ownership and permitted use of final deliverables, and our pre-existing tools/templates, shall follow the written scope or separately agreed license; no transfer of all intellectual property is implied merely by payment. Do not upload other parties' confidential data without authority.

### 10. Scheduling limitations

Schedule advice and deliverables depend on the customer-provided information and assumptions. They do not guarantee project completion, recovery of delay, approval from an employer/authority, contract entitlement, a particular commercial outcome or the accuracy of unverified quantities. Expert delay analysis, legal opinions, extension-of-time claims and independent engineering certifications are outside the standard scope unless expressly contracted.

### 11. Cancellation, refunds and mandatory rights

The [Cancellation & Refund Policy](https://bluefintuna.life/refund-policy.html) forms part of these terms. As a proposed policy, a valid cancellation before work starts ordinarily qualifies for a refund, except separately disclosed and lawfully agreed third-party expenses. After work starts, any refund should reasonably reflect work performed and applicable legal rights. Delivery defects are reviewed for correction, completion or other remedies. There is no blanket `all sales final` waiver. Mandatory consumer rights, including statutory withdrawal rights where applicable, prevail over these terms. Where a customer requests performance during a legally protected cancellation period, any required express request or acknowledgment must be handled separately and lawfully.

### 12. Contact, applicable law and changes

Questions, change requests, cancellations and complaints may be sent to **support@bluefintuna.life** with the order/project reference. Governing law, dispute jurisdiction, commercial liability terms and legally required business address disclosures must be approved and accurately published before live use; this draft intentionally does not impose an unreviewed universal jurisdiction or liability waiver. The terms version accepted for a completed order remains associated with that order; later changes apply prospectively unless otherwise agreed and lawful.


### Draft implementation notes

The proposed business-day calendar is Monday to Friday in UTC, with holidays and exceptions confirmed in the order scope before acceptance. Neither this calendar nor the proposed retention policy is legally effective until approved. Customer invitations are single-use and normally expire in 24 hours; activated sessions last up to one hour. Within the stated delivery window, ask the operator for a new invitation when needed. Publication is not proof that the customer has downloaded or accepted the work.

# Bluefin Tuna LLC — Cancellation & Refund Policy

**DRAFT FOR OWNER AND QUALIFIED LEGAL REVIEW — NOT YET EFFECTIVE**

**Version:** `service-terms-2026-10-30-v1` (common agreement bundle). Proposed effective date: pending written approval. This policy forms part of the [Service Terms](/service-terms.html) for the selected planning service and its itemized compatible add-ons, not a separate product-specific contract.

## Before work starts

A valid cancellation before work starts ordinarily qualifies for a refund of amounts paid, except separately disclosed and lawfully agreed third-party expenses actually incurred. Such expenses must be explained and approved in advance; this draft does not assume they exist.

## After work starts

Any deduction should reasonably reflect documented work already performed and lawful, disclosed expenses. Explain the calculation and any refund of unperformed work. There is no blanket all-sales-final rule. Mandatory statutory rights prevail.

## Missing inputs, deadlines and expired upload sessions

The four-to-twelve-business-day package estimates begin after complete usable inputs are accepted, scope is confirmed and payment conditions are met, not merely on payment. Missing information may require a communicated pause or revised scope. An expired 12-hour R2 intake session does not automatically forfeit payment or cancellation rights. A verified paid customer may receive a new operator-authorized upload session without another charge. If the service cannot be supplied, agree a lawful remedy reflecting actual work performed.

## Defective or incomplete delivery

Report missing, corrupted or materially nonconforming files with the order reference. We review the purchased scope and, as appropriate, correct, complete, refund or provide another remedy consistent with mandatory rights. Publication or download logs alone do not prove acceptance of satisfactory performance. The proposed 30-day delivery window and 90-day private archive schedule do not shorten legal rights.

## Consumer rights and early performance

Applicable consumer withdrawal rights remain in force. Any legally required express request to begin performance during a protected cancellation period, and any acknowledgment concerning loss of withdrawal rights, must be handled separately. The general Service Terms checkbox is not such an express waiver. Applicable jurisdiction, business/consumer classification, refund processing timelines and seller address must be reviewed before live sales.

## Requests and records

Contact support@bluefintuna.life with your order/project reference. Do not send payment-card credentials or confidential project attachments. Refunds are processed through the original payment provider where applicable; final processing times must be accurately confirmed. Order, consent, payment and accounting records may have a separate legally justified retention schedule pending approval. See the [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html).

## App Store purchases remain separate

This planning-service policy does not replace Apple's purchase/refund process or existing app privacy disclosures. For an App Store purchase use [Apple purchase support](https://reportaproblem.apple.com/). For application help use [Bluefin Tuna support](/support/).

# Project planning portal — proposed privacy supplement

**DRAFT FOR OWNER AND QUALIFIED LEGAL REVIEW — NOT YET EFFECTIVE**

**Agreement bundle:** `service-terms-2026-10-30-v1`. This proposed supplement applies only to the new planning-service portal. The existing website/business policy and application privacy disclosures at this URL remain unchanged for those services. Production customer intake is not enabled by this draft.

## Information and purposes

The proposed service processes customer/project contact details, selected package and add-ons, project documents, delivery instructions, order and payment-provider references, versioned acceptance evidence and limited security/download audit records to quote and perform the service, verify payments and agreement acceptance, prevent abuse and address support requests. Legal bases, lawful cross-border arrangements and exact record retention periods require review before live activation. Do not upload personal data beyond what is necessary or documents you lack authority to share.

## Providers and access

Cloudflare Workers processes requests; private R2 holds temporary intake; D1 stores order, agreement and audit metadata; Cloudflare Access protects admin endpoints and Turnstile helps prevent abuse. Stripe hosts payment entry and processes payments; Bluefin does not collect or store full card credentials or Stripe secret keys in acceptance records. After verified payment, documents may be copied to the owner's private, access-controlled personal Google Drive workspace using the minimum drive.file scope. This personal-account arrangement requires owner/legal approval before production. Refresh tokens are encrypted in backend storage; encryption keys and provider secrets stay in Worker Secrets. Customers do not receive OAuth tokens, Drive IDs or Google sharing links.

## Retention and delivery

R2 access ends exactly 12 hours after upload-session creation, paid or unpaid; scheduled physical deletion may follow later and can be delayed by incidents. Payment never extends that deadline. Proposed private working storage lasts for the project term, customer access lasts 30 days after final publication, and private archive deletion is scheduled 90 days after publication, subject to documented lawful holds and operational cleanup delays. These are separate from the R2 deadline. Customer access uses a single-use invitation (normally 24 hours), a short Secure HttpOnly session (up to one hour) and optional separately delivered passcode; a new invitation may be needed within the delivery window. No Google customer account is required. Necessary order/acceptance/accounting records may remain separately; final retention and deletion rules require approval.

## Security, communication and rights

Only the order-access holder and authorized operators may access permitted project data. Initial delivery messages are sent manually by the owner; no marketing consent is bundled with contract acceptance. No EU-only storage or residency guarantee is made: Cloudflare, Stripe and Google may process data across borders under arrangements to be reviewed. Privacy requests can be sent to support@bluefintuna.life or the existing published contact channels; do not include passwords, access codes or identity documents in an initial message. We assess applicable access, correction, deletion and other rights under the relevant law. Reading this notice is not a blanket waiver of privacy rights. Existing [Contact](/contact/) and [App Support](/support/) routes remain available.
